scale.L2: ASSISTED: completes bounded work with guidance
scale.L4: ADVANCED: handles abnormal or complex conditions
scale.L5: EXPERT: designs methods and mentors other crews
scale.L6: AUTHORITY: defines canonical rules or approves bounded state

dimensions.discovery: Find repos, branches, files, systems, dependencies and unexplored surfaces.
dimensions.deep_reading: Read code, documents, logs, issues, history and interfaces without substituting assumptions for evidence.
dimensions.architecture: Model functions, roles, nodes, edges, authority, lineage and temporal structure.
dimensions.planning: Turn target state into bounded actions, dependencies, resources, gates and victory conditions.
dimensions.build_repair: Create, modify, debug and repair implementation artifacts.
dimensions.runtime_execution: Execute real >0-step probes, workflows, tests and operational procedures.
dimensions.evidence_provenance: Produce and challenge exact-source, exact-SHA, receipt and independent-consumer evidence.
dimensions.analysis_pca_bt: Use DMAIC, measured PCA, BT and reverse pressure to rank interventions and expose latent workload structure.
dimensions.operations_control: Operate stable capability, monitor recurrence and apply bounded CONTROL rules.
dimensions.rex_learning: Assimilate lessons, prevent recurrence, update doctrine and generate reusable REX.

evidence_classes.TARGET_PROFILE: Desired competency for a role that is not yet proven.
evidence_classes.EXPERT_SEEDED_FROM_OBSERVED_ROLE: Planning prior inferred from an observed role definition; not measured competence.
evidence_classes.EXPERT_SEEDED_FROM_OBSERVED_M09_ROLE: Planning prior anchored to observed M09 work; still not measured competence.
evidence_classes.EXPERT_SEEDED_FROM_OBSERVED_ROLE_ALIASES: Planning prior for an observed surface represented under multiple role names.
evidence_classes.MEASURED: Derived from accepted mission/runtime receipts and reproducible telemetry.

competence_formula: knowledge + skill + tool_access + runtime_experience + evidence_quality + decision_authority + REX_history + repeatability
